ISIN.name: ISIN
ISIN.definition: Code used to identify the financial instrument.

MostRelevantMarket.name: Most Relevant Market
MostRelevantMarket.definition: The most relevant market in terms of liquidity shall be the trading venue where that financial instrument is first admitted to trading or first traded.

OutputData.name: Output Data
OutputData.definition: Output data covering both the continuous order book and auction trading system.

PublicationDateTime.name: Publication Date Time
PublicationDateTime.definition: Date and time when the transaction was published by the data contributors.

DisseminationDateTime.name: Dissemination Date Time
DisseminationDateTime.definition: Date and time when the output data were disseminated by the CTP.
